summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K to furnish a press release dated May 12, 2026, announcing its participation in the 2026 European Hematology Association Congress and the presentation of 17 clinical advances for its drug candidates. The filing contains no terms of any transaction, no board recommendation, no advisor, and no special situation mechanics. It is a routine disclosure of scientific conference participation and clinical data updates. This is a standard periodic report by a foreign private issuer; accordingly, the filing does not trigger any special-situation classification.
